Processing Layer: Flink jobs for: 1) Metrics aggregation (5-min tumbling windows, compute baselines). 2) Transaction scoring (per-event, enriched with customer history from DynamoDB). 3) Network flow analysis (session reconstruction, 1-min windows). 4) Cross-signal correlation (joins across streams on time windows). Correlation Engine: When anomaly detected in any stream, query other streams for concurrent anomalies within +/- 5 min window. Composite score = weighted sum of individual anomaly scores. If composite > threshold, escalate as potential coordinated attack. Storage: Hot (real-time): Redis for current state, last 1 hour. Warm (analysis): OpenSearch for last 30 days, full-text search. Cold (compliance): S3 Parquet for long-term retention. Output: Real-time dashboard (Grafana), PagerDuty alerts, automated remediation triggers, weekly trend reports. Scale: Handle 100K events/sec across all streams with <5 second end-to-end latency.

expected_answer: Monte Carlo Parameters: Infrastructure Incidents: Frequency: Poisson(lambda=1/month). Duration: LogNormal(mu=20min, sigma=15min). Impact: Normal(mu=$35K, sigma=$15K). Fraud Events: Frequency: Poisson(lambda=4/month). Success rate: Beta(alpha=2, beta=8) ~20%. Loss per event: LogNormal(mu=$8K, sigma=$5K). Security Breaches: Frequency: Poisson(lambda=0.33/month). Data volume: LogNormal(mu=500KB, sigma=300KB). Cost per breach: LogNormal(mu=$500K, sigma=$200K). Simulation (10,000 iterations): Expected annual loss: Mean $1.8M, P95 $3.2M, P99 $4.5M. With mitigations ($600K investment): Expected annual loss: Mean $450K, P95 $900K, P99 $1.5M. Value at Risk (95%): $3.2M unmitigated, $900K mitigated. Recommendation: Investment has positive expected value of $1.35M/year (mean) with payback period < 6 months.

system_prompt: You are a data analyst specializing in anomaly detection. Analyze the provided data and identify anomalies with clear reasoning.
user_prompt: Create a threat model for the entire system based on observed vulnerabilities.
expected_answer: STRIDE Threat Model: Spoofing: Attacker used compromised credentials for fraud (T004-T006). Mitigation: MFA, behavioral biometrics, device fingerprinting. Tampering: No evidence of data tampering, but attacker had write access via SSH. Mitigation: File integrity monitoring, immutable infrastructure. Repudiation: Attacker used unknown device (T006), making attribution harder. Mitigation: Enhanced logging, non-repudiation controls. Information Disclosure: 870KB exfiltrated via C2 channel. Mitigation: DLP, network segmentation, encryption at rest. Denial of Service: Infrastructure overwhelmed at 15:00 (intentional or organic). Mitigation: Auto-scaling, CDN, rate limiting, WAF. Elevation of Privilege: SSH lateral movement from compromised host. Mitigation: Zero-trust, least privilege, network microsegmentation. Attack Surface: Web applications (entry point), SSH (lateral movement), payment system (fraud target), monitoring gaps (detection delay). Priority fixes: 1) Network segmentation, 2) MFA everywhere, 3) EDR deployment, 4) DLP controls.

system_prompt: You are a data analyst specializing in anomaly detection. Analyze the provided data and identify anomalies with clear reasoning.
user_prompt: Design a comprehensive security operations center (SOC) monitoring strategy that would detect and respond to all observed attack patterns within 5 minutes.
expected_answer: SOC Strategy: Detection Layer: 1) SIEM (Splunk/Elastic): Correlate logs from all sources, custom detection rules for observed patterns. 2) NDR (Network Detection): Zeek/Suricata for network flow analysis, detect C2, scanning, exfiltration. 3) EDR (Endpoint): CrowdStrike/SentinelOne on all hosts, detect process anomalies, file access. 4) UEBA (User Behavior): Detect impossible travel, unusual transaction patterns, credential abuse. 5) SOAR (Automation): Playbooks for auto-containment within 2 minutes of detection. Detection Rules (< 5 min SLA): Rule 1: SSH connections to >3 hosts in 60s from single source -> alert in 60s. Rule 2: Outbound traffic >100KB to new external IP on non-standard port -> alert in 30s. Rule 3: Transaction velocity >3x customer baseline in 5 min -> alert in real-time. Rule 4: Service error rate >5x baseline for >2 min -> alert in 2 min. Rule 5: Cross-signal: any 2 rules firing within 10 min window -> escalate to P1. Team: 2 analysts 24/7 (follow-the-sun), 1 incident responder on-call. Metrics: MTTD < 5 min, MTTR < 30 min for P1. Cost: ~$1.2M/year (tools + team). ROI: Prevents $2.5M+ in annual losses.
